decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual speakers rather than accessories like cases or cables. My consideration set included high-end portable speakers from reputable brands like JBL, Bose, and Sony, as well as a unique wearable neckband speaker and a budget-friendly option. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because of its exceptionally high rating (4.8) across over 16,000 reviews, indicating consistent performance in sound quality and battery life, making it the most reliable choice in this product feed.
